title: Tīng Wen Taihou He Taihou Shi Zhen De?!
titleRomaji: Tīng Wen Taihou He Taihou Shi Zhen De?!
titleNative: 听闻太后和太后是真的？！
synonyms: I heard that the Queen Mother and the Queen Mother are real?!
I Heard That Both of Our Empress Dowagers Have Something Together?
synopsis: Jiang Shu is a graduate student in the History Department. When she accidentally travels back in time to the Qi dynasty, she remembers exactly how the history went. She knows that Qi Changning is a famously tyrannical queen, regarded as a villainess in the history books. Jiang Shu was content to play along and act like an obsequious lap-dog in order to survive. However, as she spends more time with the queen, she discovers details hidden from the history books. The "demon queen" doesn't seem to be as bad as what she had read… (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Myther
synopsis: In the 2nd year of Enka, a scientist invented Myther, a device designed to create an ideal personality. With it, people could become their ideal selves and break away from their weak selves. However, underneath the surface, Myther Crime - a hidden social issue - has emerged, where those who abuse Myther suffer from their minds breaking, before carrying out horrific acts of violence. Kyou, an agent of the Special Intelligence Agency under direct command of the Japanese authorities, secretly takes on the fight against these crimes. All for the sake of his unwavering loyalty to the government… (Source: Kodansha, translated)

titleNative: 漫画 ゆうえんち-バキ外伝
synopsis: The boy asked the man, the man answered....."I've been there, in the Korakuen Arena, fought against Hanayama Kaoru, it was amazing." The boy asked him again but this time a question that terrified him to the core 'Where's the amusement park?" the man had no answer. This is a series of illustrated tales about a dark place inside the world of the Baki series, the so-called "Amusement Park" come and discover by yourself why strong men fear it so much. Take a peek at darkness itself!!!

synopsis: Moments before victory, dark mage Kai Austin is betrayed and loses everything. His death becomes a reset, sending him five years into the past—to the day of the class assignment ceremony—with all of his magic intact. Armed with max-level dark magic and every memory of the future, Kai refuses to let history repeat itself. This time, he will protect Colette, stop the coming disasters before they begin, and destroy those who once betrayed him. (Source: WEBTOON)

title: Real demo Shiawase ni Shite Kudasai ne?
titleRomaji: Real demo Shiawase ni Shite Kudasai ne?
titleNative: 現実世界でも幸せにしてくださいね？
synonyms: Be Happy in the Real World Too, Okay?
synopsis: High school girl Machino, who longs for the "love of destiny," loves to play the dating-sim game "Celestia." Despite maximizing the affection with all of the girls in the game, she can't decide on which one to choose for the confession event. After agonizing over the decision for days, an explosion occurs just as a shooting star flies over her house, and when Machino opens her eyes, she finds herself face to face with Sofia, the main heroine of Celestia.... "Machino... I always wanted to say it... I love you." An isekai summoning yuri harem romantic comedy begins, as her highly affectionate heroines jump into the real world! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
